_doc: M7-04 — the strings the Chapter Select screen (S04) shows, and nothing else. It exists because X-04 requires every user-facing string to be a loc key in EN and DE from day one, and because ContentInvariants.CheckLocaleKeyReferences fails a loc key that nothing in the content set names — a key referenced only from C# is an orphan, and an orphan is fatal. The chapter NAMES are not here: each chapter document carries its own displayName key (content/chapters/*.json), so a chapter added later brings its name with it rather than needing a second edit here. The tier ladder itself is authored in tuning/progression.json#/chapterGating and is read from there, never transcribed into code or into this file. There is deliberately no par-power or expected-power caption: the power readout is a separate row's and a caption here would invite a power comparison this screen must not make.
title: loc.chapter_select.title.name
